lemmas.def_en: painting that applies the pigment thickly so that brush or palette knife marks are visible

examples.en: The dramatic painting made extensive use of thick impasto to create texture.
examples.zh: 这幅引人注目的画作大量使用了厚涂颜料技法来营造质感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impasto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无孔的, 无齿孔的, 闭锁的
lemmas.def_en: not perforated; having no opening

examples.en: Stamp collectors eagerly competed to buy the rare imperforate sheet at auction.
examples.zh: 集邮者们在拍卖会上踊跃竞购那张罕见的无齿孔整版邮票。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imperforate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: worm that is parasitic on the intestines of vertebrates especially roundworms and tapeworms and flukes

examples.en: The veterinarian prescribed medication to clear the parasitic helminth from the puppy.
examples.zh: 兽医开了药物以清除幼犬体内的寄生蠕虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 helminth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 漫无止境地; 没完没了地; 无限地; 冗长地
lemmas.def_en: all the time; seemingly without stopping

examples.en: The boring afternoon lecture dragged on interminably, making several students fall asleep.
examples.zh: 那场枯燥的午后讲座冗长得没完没了，让好几个学生都睡着了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interminably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 柔术, 柔道(日本的一种武术)
lemmas.def_en: a method of self-defense without weapons that was developed in China and Japan; holds and blows are supplemented by clever use of the attacker's own weight and strength

examples.en: He practices jiujitsu three times a week to improve his self-defense skills.
examples.zh: 他每周练习三次柔术，以提升自己的防身技能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jiujitsu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of information equal to 1000 bits

examples.en: The embedded sensor transmits a single kbit of telemetry data every second.
examples.zh: 该嵌入式传感器每秒传输一千位的遥测数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kbit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: key for raising or drawing back a latch or opening an outside door

examples.en: He nervously fumbled for his brass latchkey in the dark hallway.
examples.zh: 他在漆黑的门厅里紧张地摸索着自己的黄铜弹簧锁钥匙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 latchkey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone with an irrational urge to steal in the absence of an economic motive

examples.en: The shop owner realized the wealthy thief was actually a troubled kleptomaniac.
examples.zh: 店主意识到这位富有的行窃者实际上是个饱受困扰的窃盗癖患者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kleptomaniac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 圆形的, 循环性格的
lemmas.def_en: resembling a circle

examples.en: The physics professor demonstrated the cycloid motion of a rolling bicycle wheel.
examples.zh: 物理教授演示了自行车轮滚动的摆线运动轨迹。

lemmas.def_en: resembling a circle

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cycloid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very generous

examples.en: The local museum expanded its galleries thanks to a munificent private donation.
examples.zh: 得益于一笔丰厚的私人捐款，当地博物馆扩建了展厅。

lemmas.def_en: in a generous manner

examples.en: he gave liberally to several charities

lemmas.def_en: liberality in bestowing gifts; extremely liberal and generous of spirit

examples.en: The university library was built through the munificence of a local donor.
examples.zh: 这所大学图书馆是靠一位当地捐赠者的慷慨解囊建成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 munificent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 纵向射击, 易受纵射的位置
lemmas.def_en: gunfire directed along the length rather than the breadth of a formation

examples.en: Enemy machine guns placed the narrow trench in a deadly enfilade.
examples.zh: 敌人的机枪对狭窄的战壕进行了致命的纵向射击。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (military) To fire along the entire length of an enemy trench, line of troops, or road.

examples.en: Enemy machine guns placed the narrow trench in a deadly enfilade.
examples.zh: 敌人的机枪对狭窄的战壕进行了致命的纵向射击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enfilade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 与假想敌作拳击训练, 推委
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (boxing) To practice boxing punches and footwork in the air against an imaginary opponent.

examples.en: The boxer spent ten minutes shadowboxing in front of the large gym mirror.
examples.zh: 拳击手在健身房的大镜子前练习了十分钟假想空击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shadowbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 男方亲属的, 宗族的
lemmas.def_en: related on the father's side

examples.en: Under ancient Roman law, inheritance rights were strictly limited to agnate relatives.
examples.zh: 根据古罗马法，继承权严格限于父系宗族亲属。

lemmas.def_en: related on the father's side

examples.en: a paternal aunt

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agnate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 迷惑, 奴役, 迷住
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (US spelling of enthral) To hold someone's attention and interest completely.

examples.en: The magician's stunning performance managed to enthrall the entire audience instantly.
examples.zh: 魔术师令人惊叹的表演瞬间迷住了全场观众。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of great liking for something wonderful and unusual

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enthrall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dirty untidy woman

examples.en: He was harshly criticized for associating with a disreputable local trollop.
examples.zh: 他因与当地一个声名狼藉的风骚女人交往而受到严厉批评。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trollop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生脓, 化脓, 流脓
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (medicine) When an infected wound suppurates, it forms and discharges pus.

examples.en: The untreated wound began to suppurate, causing intense pain and high fever.
examples.zh: 未处理的伤口开始化脓，引起了剧烈的疼痛和高烧。

lemmas.def_zh: 生脓, 化脓, 流脓
lemmas.def_en: (medicine) the formation of morbific matter in an abscess or a vesicle and the discharge of pus

lemmas.def_zh: 使化脓的, 化脓性的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or characterized by suppuration

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suppurate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small European finch with a cheerful song

examples.en: A colorful chaffinch perched on the garden fence and sang sweetly.
examples.zh: 一只色彩艳丽的苍头燕雀停在花园篱笆上婉转啼鸣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chaffinch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small very thin pancake

examples.en: She wore a black crape veil to the solemn funeral ceremony.
examples.zh: 她戴着黑色的丧礼绉纱面纱参加了庄严的葬礼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crape 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the outermost layer of the epidermis consisting of dead cells that slough off

examples.en: This moisturizing cream protects the stratum corneum from dry winter weather.
examples.zh: 这款保湿霜可保护角质层免受冬季干燥天气的影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corneum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用贝壳或贝壳状容器盛的菜
lemmas.def_en: seafood served in a scallop shell

examples.en: The chef served a delicate seafood coquille baked with rich cheese.
examples.zh: 厨师端上了一道用浓郁芝士烘烤的精致贝壳海鲜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coquille 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lacking in sympathy or feeling

examples.en: Only a truly coldhearted person could ignore a crying child's plea.
examples.zh: 只有真正冷酷无情的人才会无视哭泣孩子的恳求。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coldhearted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 晒衣绳上夹衣服之夹子
lemmas.def_en: wood or plastic fastener; for holding clothes on a clothesline

examples.en: She secured the wet shirts to the clothesline using a wooden clothespin.
examples.zh: 她用木衣夹把湿衬衫牢牢固定在晒衣绳上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clothespin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 堂区俗人委员, 陶制的长烟斗
lemmas.def_en: an officer in the Episcopal church who helps a parish priest with secular matters

examples.en: The village churchwarden spent his evening smoking a traditional clay pipe.
examples.zh: 村里的堂区委员整个晚上都在抽着传统的黏土长烟斗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 churchwarden 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woolen tunic worn by men and women in ancient Greece

examples.en: The ancient Greek actor wore a flowing chiton for the tragedy.
examples.zh: 那位古希腊演员身穿一件飘逸的长袍出演悲剧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chiton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: common Indian weaverbird

examples.en: A male baya expertly wove a complex hanging nest in the tree.
examples.zh: 一只雄性织布鸟在树上熟练地编织了一个复杂的悬挂巢。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baya 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a form of rummy using two decks of cards and four jokers; jokers and deuces are wild; the object is to form groups of the same rank

examples.en: The elderly couple played canasta together every Saturday evening without fail.
examples.zh: 这对老夫妇每周六晚上都必定会一起玩纸牌游戏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 canasta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sweet almond-flavored milk pudding thickened with gelatin or cornstarch; usually molded

examples.en: For dessert, grandmother prepared a traditional almond blancmange with fresh berries.
examples.zh: 至于甜点，祖母准备了配有新鲜浆果的传统杏仁牛奶冻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blancmange 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the freezing of a seriously ill or recently deceased person to stop tissues from decomposing; the body is preserved until new medical cures are developed that might bring the person back to life

examples.en: Advocates of cryonics hope future technology can revive deep-frozen human bodies.
examples.zh: 人体冷冻学的倡导者希望未来的科技能复活深度冷冻的人体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cryonics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bright green fabric napped to resemble felt; used to cover gaming tables

examples.en: He lined up his shot carefully across the smooth green baize table.
examples.zh: 他在这张平整的绿色台呢球桌上仔细瞄准击球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 倒踏脚踏板, 后退, 变卦
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ on) To pedal backward on a bicycle; to retreat from or soften a previous statement or commitment.

examples.en: Facing fierce public backlash, the politician quickly attempted to backpedal on his statement.
examples.zh: 面对公众的强烈反对，这位政客迅速试图收回自己的言论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backpedal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: long-legged web-footed black-and-white shorebird with slender upward-curving bill

examples.en: An elegant avocet used its curved beak to forage in the shallow water.
examples.zh: 一只优雅的反嘴鹬用它弯曲的喙在浅水中觅食。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 avocet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: economic independence as a national policy

examples.en: The isolated regime pursued total autarky, avoiding any foreign trade completely.
examples.zh: 这个孤立的政权追求彻底的自给自足，完全避免任何对外贸易。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autarky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: submerged marine plant with very long narrow leaves found in abundance along North Atlantic coasts

examples.en: Dense beds of eelgrass provide vital shelter for young fish along the coast.
examples.zh: 茂密的大叶藻群为沿海的幼鱼提供了至关重要的庇护所。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eelgrass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Ranunculus

examples.en: She spotted a yellow crowfoot blooming near the edge of the damp meadow.
examples.zh: 她看到一朵黄色的毛茛盛开在潮湿草地的边缘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crowfoot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: entertainment that is intended to be educational

examples.en: The interactive museum specializes in edutainment designed to engage young minds.
examples.zh: 这座互动博物馆专注于旨在吸引年轻人的寓教于乐项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 edutainment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a garden featuring rocks; usually alpine plants

examples.en: He planted delicate alpine flowers among the stones of the garden rockery.
examples.zh: 他在花园假山的石缝间种下了娇嫩的高山花卉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rockery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 思睡, 困倦, 瞌睡, 嗜眠, 嗜眠症
lemmas.def_en: a very sleepy state

examples.en: A heavy afternoon lunch induced a wave of pleasant somnolence across the room.
examples.zh: 丰盛的午餐让整个房间里的人都泛起了一阵舒服的困意。

lemmas.def_en: inclined to or marked by drowsiness

examples.en: The warm afternoon sun created a somnolent atmosphere across the quiet village square.
examples.zh: 温暖的午后阳光在宁静的村庄广场上营造出一种昏昏欲睡的氛围。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 somnolence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ridge that forms a seam between two parts

examples.en: The surgeon carefully examined the palatine raphe running along the roof of the mouth.
examples.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了沿着口腔上颚延伸的腭缝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 raphe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 能被描绘的, 能上演的, 能被表现的, 能被代表的, 能被描述的
lemmas.def_en: expressible in symbolic form

examples.en: These complex mathematical models are easily representable in a three-dimensional graph.
examples.zh: 这些复杂的数学模型很容易在三维图表中表现出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 representable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to law or to legal rights and obligations

examples.en: The committee consulted several juristic scholars before finalizing the constitutional draft.
examples.zh: 委员会在敲定宪法草案前咨询了几位法学学者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 juristic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: newly formed outer wood lying between the cambium and the heartwood of a tree or woody plant; usually light colored; active in water conduction

examples.en: Fungi attacked the softer outer sapwood, leaving the inner heartwood intact.
examples.zh: 真菌侵蚀了较软的外层边材，而内部的心材完好无损。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sapwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fatal disease of sheep characterized by chronic itching and loss of muscular control and progressive degeneration of the central nervous system

examples.en: Strict veterinary controls were enforced to prevent the fatal spread of scrapie in sheep.
examples.zh: 当局实施了严格的兽医管制，以防止羊瘙痒病的致命传播。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scrapie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻度经济衰退,股票市场震动
lemmas.def_en: an economic condition that results in the elimination of marginally financed participants in an industry

examples.en: Only the most resilient startups survived the sudden shakeout in the tech market.
examples.zh: 只有最具韧性的初创企业在科技市场的突发震荡中幸存下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shakeout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 封套, 套子, 沙发套
lemmas.def_en: a removable fitted cloth covering for upholstered furniture

examples.en: She washed the floral slipcover to protect the new sofa from cat hair.
examples.zh: 她清洗了碎花沙发套，以保护新沙发免沾猫毛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slipcover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a worker engaged in making steel

examples.en: Before refuting her opponent, she tried to steelman his central argument fairly.
examples.zh: 在反驳对手之前，她尽量客气地强化并完善对方的核心论点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 steelman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: act of writing in code or cipher

examples.en: Spies utilized digital steganography to conceal secret messages inside harmless image files.
examples.zh: 间谍利用数字隐写术将秘密信息隐藏在无害的图像文件中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 steganography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 对...加注表示'不删'/'保留'的符号
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (printing / editing) To mark proofread text with 'stet' to show that a cancelled word should remain unchanged.

examples.en: The editor marked the deleted sentence with stet to keep it in the final print.
examples.zh: 编辑在被删句子旁标注了“保留”，以留在最终印刷版中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a primitive wind instrument consisting of several parallel pipes bound together

examples.en: The songbird produced a remarkably complex melody using its specialized vocal syrinx.
examples.zh: 这只鸣禽利用其特化的鸣管发出了极其复杂的旋律。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 syrinx 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a powerful neurotoxin found in the ovaries of pufferfish

examples.en: Improperly prepared pufferfish contains tetrodotoxin, a deadly neurotoxin with no known antidote.
examples.zh: 处理不当的河豚含有河豚毒素，这是一种没有已知解毒剂的致命神经毒素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tetrodotoxin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 稳健的, 头脑冷静的；明智的
lemmas.def_en: exercising or showing good judgment

examples.en: During the chaotic evacuation, she remained remarkably levelheaded and guided everyone outside.
examples.zh: 在混乱的疏散过程中，她表现得异常冷静，引导大家走到了室外。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 levelheaded 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 变性,有易性癖,改变性别
lemmas.def_en: condition in which a person assumes the identity and permanently acts the part of the gender opposite to his or her biological sex

examples.en: The medical textbook outlines psychological and clinical approaches to managing transsexualism.
examples.zh: 这本医学教科书概述了应对易性症的心理学和临床方法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transsexualism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 四个一组, 四个一套, 四元数
lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of three and one

examples.en: Video game developers often use a quaternion to compute smooth three-dimensional rotations.
examples.zh: 电子游戏开发者经常使用四元数来计算平滑的三维旋转。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quaternion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 没彩排过的；没有提前准备过的
lemmas.def_en: with little or no preparation or forethought

examples.en: The comedian delighted the audience with a brilliant, entirely unrehearsed opening monologue.
examples.zh: 这位喜剧演员以精彩且完全没有排练过的开场独白逗乐了观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unrehearsed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who talks incessantly

examples.en: Nobody could get a word in because the persistent motormouth dominated the call.
examples.zh: 谁也插不上话，因为那个喋喋不休的话匣子主导了通话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 motormouth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ions are accelerated along a linear path by voltage differences on electrodes along the path

examples.en: The hospital installed a modern linac to deliver targeted radiation for cancer treatments.
examples.zh: 医院安装了一台现代化的直线加速器，用于为癌症治疗提供靶向放疗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 linac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小偷, 骗子, 间谍
lemmas.def_en: someone waiting in concealment

examples.en: The detective suspected the shady newcomer was actually a lurcher watching their movements.
examples.zh: 侦探怀疑那个形迹可疑的新人实际上是个监视他们行踪的间谍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lurcher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having an unpleasant smell

examples.en: Workers refused to enter the basement until the malodorous puddle was cleaned up.
examples.zh: 工人们拒绝进入地下室，直到那滩发臭的积水被清理干净。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 malodorous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large African black-and-white carrion-eating stork; its downy underwing feathers are used to trim garments

examples.en: A solitary marabou stood motionless near the drying riverbank under the blazing sun.
examples.zh: 一只秃鹳在烈日下孤零零地立在干涸的河岸边，一动不动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marabou 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the evacuation of persons (usually by air transportation) to a place where they can receive medical care

examples.en: The military called in a medivac to transport the wounded soldier immediately.
examples.zh: 军方呼叫了医疗后送直升机，立即转运这名受伤的士兵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 medivac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the sound made by a cat (or any sound resembling this)

examples.en: The hungry kitten gave a plaintive miaow outside the kitchen door this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，那只饥饿的小猫在厨房门外发出哀怨的叫声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 miaow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (相传住在古希腊中部的)米尼安人；(犹太教)举行正式礼拜仪式的法定人数(至少须有10名13岁以上的男子)
lemmas.def_en: the quorum required by Jewish law to be present for public worship (at least ten males over thirteen years of age)

examples.en: They needed one more adult male to form a proper minyan for prayer.
examples.zh: 他们还需要一名成年男性才能凑齐举行祈祷法定的十人人数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minyan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: plant cultivated for its enlarged fleshy turnip-shaped edible stem

examples.en: She chopped the fresh kohlrabi into thin matchsticks for a crunchy summer salad.
examples.zh: 她把新鲜的撇蓝切成细丝，做成爽脆的夏季沙拉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kohlrabi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the fleshy part of the human body that you sit on

examples.en: The doctor examined the deep bruise spreading across the patient's left nates.
examples.zh: 医生检查了患者左侧臀部大面积扩散的深色瘀伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nates 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a canonical hour that is the ninth hour of the day counting from sunrise

examples.en: Monks gathered in the chapel at mid-afternoon to recite the prayers of none.
examples.zh: 僧侣们午后聚集在小教堂里，吟诵申正经的祷文。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nones 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 核合成; 元素的核合成
lemmas.def_en: (astronomy) the cosmic synthesis of atoms more complex than the hydrogen atom

examples.en: Scientists study primordial nucleosynthesis to understand the origin of the lightest chemical elements.
examples.zh: 科学家研究太初核合成，以了解最轻化学元素的起源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nucleosynthesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mechanical device used to copy a figure or plan on a different scale

examples.en: The draftsman used a metal pantograph to scale down the complex mechanical drawing.
examples.zh: 绘图员使用金属缩放仪按比例缩小了复杂的机械图纸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pantograph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 危险的, 不易对付的, 精明的, 麻烦的
lemmas.def_en: fraught with danger

examples.en: The country's economy remained in a parlous state despite the emergency government intervention.
examples.zh: 尽管政府采取了紧急干预措施，该国经济仍处于险恶境地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parlous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sailor's heavy woolen double-breasted jacket

examples.en: He buttoned his navy peacoat tightly against the biting winter wind along the pier.
examples.zh: 他系紧海军蓝厚呢短大衣的纽扣，抵御码头上刺骨的冬风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peacoat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in an unpardonable manner or to an unpardonable degree

examples.en: The manager behaved unforgivably when he blamed his loyal staff for his own mistakes.
examples.zh: 经理把自己犯的错误归咎于忠诚的员工，这种行为不可原谅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unforgivably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a B vitamin that prevents beriberi; maintains appetite and growth

examples.en: Whole grains and legumes are rich dietary sources of essential thiamin for human health.
examples.zh: 全谷物和豆类富含对人体健康至关重要的硫胺素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thiamin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or involving excess nitrogenous waste products in the urine (usually due to kidney insufficiency)

examples.en: The patient displayed common uremic symptoms that required immediate dialysis to filter the blood.
examples.zh: 该患者表现出常见的尿毒症症状，需要立即透析以过滤血液。

lemmas.def_en: accumulation in the blood of nitrogenous waste products (urea) that are usually excreted in the urine

examples.en: Chronic kidney failure can lead to uremia, causing toxic wastes to accumulate dangerously.
examples.zh: 慢性肾衰竭会导致尿毒症，使有毒废物在体内危险地积聚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 uremic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: severe and excessive vomiting

examples.en: Severe dehydration caused by hyperemesis forced her to stay in the hospital for observation.
examples.zh: 剧吐引起的严重脱水迫使她留在医院接受观察。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyperemesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the flesh of horses as food

examples.en: Traditional markets in certain regions still sell locally sourced horsemeat alongside other meats.
examples.zh: 某些地区的传统市场仍然与其他肉类一起销售本地来源的马肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 horsemeat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small area off of a kitchen that is used for dining

examples.en: They enjoyed quick breakfasts in the cozy dinette adjacent to their open kitchen.
examples.zh: 他们在与开放式厨房相邻的温馨小用餐区享用快捷的早餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dinette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 草本, 草, 草的柔软部分
lemmas.def_en: succulent herbaceous vegetation of pasture land

examples.en: Cattle grazed peacefully on the lush herbage that covered the rolling green hills.
examples.zh: 牛群在覆盖着起伏绿山的茂盛草丛上宁静地吃草。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 herbage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 很多, 一帽所装的量
lemmas.def_en: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent

examples.en: The ambitious new startup encountered a hatful of unexpected legal issues this month.
examples.zh: 这家雄心勃勃的初创公司本月遇到了一大堆意想不到的法律问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hatful 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: resistant to penetration by grease or oil or wax

examples.en: She wrapped the warm pastries in greaseproof paper before packing them into boxes.
examples.zh: 她在把热糕点装进盒子里之前，先用防油纸把它们包好。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greaseproof 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (musical direction) in the manner of a glissando (with a rapidly executed series of notes)

examples.en: The pianist ended the dramatic piece with a rapid glissando across the upper keys.
examples.zh: 钢琴家以高音区快速的滑音结束了这首充满戏剧性的乐曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glissando 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 吉利(一种有花边的运动鞋)
lemmas.def_en: a shoe without a tongue and with decorative lacing up the instep

examples.en: She laced up her soft leather ghillies before stepping onto the dance stage.
examples.zh: 在走上舞蹈舞台之前，她系紧了软皮吉利鞋的鞋带。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ghillie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a song that is traditionally sung by the common people of a region and forms part of their culture

examples.en: The old fisherman softly hummed a traditional folksong while mending his nets.
examples.zh: 老渔夫一边补网，一边轻声哼唱着一首传统民歌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 folksong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very good;of the highest quality

examples.en: We spent a fantabulous weekend exploring the coastal villages under the warm sun.
examples.zh: 我们在温暖的阳光下探索沿海村庄，度过了一个极棒的周末。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fantabulous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: stem of plants of the Gramineae

examples.en: Strong winds bent the slender culm of the bamboo without breaking it.
examples.zh: 强风弯折了竹子细长的秆，却没有将其折断。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 culm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: equality of distribution

examples.en: He struggled to maintain his mental equipoise amidst the chaotic corporate restructuring.
examples.zh: 在混乱的公司重组过程中，他努力保持内心的平衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 equipoise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 对映体; 对映异构体
lemmas.def_en: either one of a pair of compounds (crystals or molecules) that are mirror images on each other but are not identical

examples.en: Each enantiomer of the compound produced a completely different biological reaction in tests.
examples.zh: 该化合物的每种对映异构体在测试中都产生了截然不同的生物反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enantiomer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant of the genus Dendrobium having stems like cane and usually showy racemose flowers

examples.en: He carefully watered the rare dendrobium blooming gracefully in the humid greenhouse.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地给温室里优雅盛开的珍稀石斛浇水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dendrobium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a planet (usually Venus) seen just before sunrise in the eastern sky

examples.en: The bright daystar shone clearly in the pale sky just before the dawn.
examples.zh: 就在拂晓之前，明亮的晨星在苍白的天空中清晰闪烁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daystar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mechanical device attached to an elevated structure; rotates freely to show the direction of the wind

examples.en: The rusted copper weathervane spun wildly as the sudden autumn storm rolled in.
examples.zh: 随着突如其来的秋季风暴来袭，生锈的铜风向标疯狂地旋转着。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weathervane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (经训练的家养小动物)会到房外便溺的
lemmas.def_en: (of pets) trained to urinate and defecate outside or in a special place

examples.en: The newly adopted puppy is already housebroken and sleeps quietly through the night.
examples.zh: 新收养的小狗已经学会不在室内便溺，并且能安静地睡整觉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 housebroken 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 传染病医院, 检疫所
lemmas.def_en: hospital for persons with infectious diseases (especially leprosy)

examples.en: Sailors suspected of carrying the plague were confined to the island lazaretto.
examples.zh: 疑似携带瘟疫的水手被隔离在岛上的检疫所内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lazaretto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 旋转玩具, 旋转木马, 循环, 轮回, 变迁
lemmas.def_en: a conical child's plaything tapering to a steel point on which it can be made to spin

examples.en: He felt dizzy from the endless whirligig of modern city life and work.
examples.zh: 现代都市生活与工作的无休止变迁让他感到目眩神迷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whirligig 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a glass that has a stem and in which wine is served

examples.en: She raised her delicate crystal wineglass to propose a toast to the guests.
examples.zh: 她举起精致的水晶酒杯，向客人们敬酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wineglass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: noisy talk

examples.en: I could hardly concentrate on my book over the constant yack in the room.
examples.zh: 房间里没完没了的闲扯让我几乎无法集中精力看书。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (informal) To strike or beat forcefully with a loud, resonant blow.

examples.en: He whanged the loose fence post with a heavy wooden mallet to secure it.
examples.zh: 他用沉重的木槌猛击松动的栅栏柱以将其固定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whang 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: alcohol used as antifreeze or a solvent

examples.en: Wipe the glass surface thoroughly with isopropanol to remove any remaining oily residue.
examples.zh: 用异丙醇彻底擦拭玻璃表面，以去除残留的油性污渍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 isopropanol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of not being devout

examples.en: The philosopher was unfairly accused of irreligion simply for questioning long-standing church dogmas.
examples.zh: 这位哲学家仅仅因为质疑长期存在的教会教条，就被不公地指控为无信仰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 irreligion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 侵入, 闯入, 流入
lemmas.def_en: an inflow

examples.en: A sudden inrush of cold winter air swept through the opened front door.
examples.zh: 一股冷冽的冬日寒风顺着敞开的前门猛然涌了进来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inrush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flowing inward

examples.en: Engineers measured the volume of influent water entering the local treatment facility daily.
examples.zh: 工程师测量了每天流入当地污水处理设施的水量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 influent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wasting time

examples.en: The committee criticized the agency for its dilatory response to the urgent crisis.
examples.zh: 委员会批评该机构对这一紧急危机采取了拖拉延误的回应态度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dilatory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: marriage to a person belonging to a tribe or group other than your own as required by custom or law

examples.en: The ancient tribe strictly practiced exogamy to forge peaceful alliances with neighboring clans.
examples.zh: 这个古老部落严格实行异族通婚，以与邻近氏族建立和平联盟。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by or fit for fertilization by a flower that is not closely related

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exogamy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不小心的, 轻率的, 不注意的
lemmas.def_en: lacking in caution

examples.en: One incautious remark during the press conference damaged his political campaign severely.
examples.zh: 他在新闻发布会上的一句不慎之言严重损害了他的竞选活动。

lemmas.def_en: without caution or prudence

examples.en: one unfortunately sees historic features carelessly lost when estates fall into unsympathetic hands

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incautious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mania restricted to one thing or idea

examples.en: His obsession with finding the lost treasure gradually turned into dangerous monomania.
examples.zh: 他寻找失落宝藏的痴迷逐渐演变成危险的偏执。

lemmas.def_en: obsessed with a single subject or idea

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monomania 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: game equipment consisting of a ring of iron or circle of rope used in playing the game of quoits

examples.en: He tossed the rubber quoit carefully, aiming directly for the center peg.
examples.zh: 他小心地扔出橡胶圈环，直奔中央的木桩而去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quoit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可克服的；可超越的, 可战胜的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being surmounted or overcome

examples.en: With proper planning and teamwork, these initial difficulties should be entirely surmountable.
examples.zh: 只要做好规划和团队合作，这些初期的困难完全是可以克服的。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能克服的, 不能超越的
lemmas.def_en: not capable of being surmounted or overcome

examples.en: insurmountable disadvantages

family_guide.root_logic: 以 surmountable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the sleeve of a shirt

examples.en: He rolled up each shirtsleeve before diving into the messy repair project.
examples.zh: 在投入凌乱的修理工作之前，他卷起了衬衫袖子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shirtsleeve 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 设法脱身, 用诡计获得；用计获得, 扭身挤出, 哄骗, 伪造
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ out of) (informal) To obtain something desired through clever persuasion, manipulation, or trickery.

examples.en: She managed to wangle two backstage passes to the sold-out rock concert.
examples.zh: 她设法弄到了两张这场售罄摇滚音乐会的后台通行证。

lemmas.def_en: a deceiver who uses crafty misleading methods

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wangle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 预示, 预见, 预想
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To be an early sign, symbol, or model of something that will appear later.

examples.en: His early short stories clearly prefigure the dark themes of his later novels.
examples.zh: 他早期的短篇小说明显预示了他后期作品中的阴暗主题。

lemmas.def_zh: 预示, 预兆, 预想
lemmas.def_en: an example that prefigures or foreshadows what is to come
indistinctly prophetic

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prefigure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a firm durable fabric with a twill weave

examples.en: He wore a durable gabardine trench coat to protect against the chilly drizzle.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件耐磨的华达呢风衣以抵御微寒的细雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gabardine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a jellied candy coated with sugar crystals

examples.en: The child decorated the gingerbread house by placing a colorful gumdrop on top.
examples.zh: 孩子在姜饼屋顶放了一颗色彩斑斓的橡皮糖作为装饰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gumdrop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a strong metal bar bearing a hook to attach something to be pulled

examples.en: Inspect the tractor drawbar to make sure the heavy trailer is securely attached.
examples.zh: 检查拖拉机的牵引杆，确保重型拖车已经牢固挂接。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drawbar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the doctrine that reason is the right basis for regulating conduct

examples.en: The university encouraged freethinking and open debate among students of all backgrounds.
examples.zh: 该大学鼓励来自各种背景的学生进行自由思考和公开辩论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freethinking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the front limb (or the homologous structure in other animals, such as a flipper or wing)

examples.en: The veterinarian gently examined the cat's swollen forelimb to check for fractures.
examples.zh: 兽医轻柔地检查了猫肿胀的前肢，看是否有骨折。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forelimb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a worker in charge of a lock (on a canal)

examples.en: The lockman operated the heavy steel gates to let the canal barge through.
examples.zh: 水闸管理人操作沉重的钢门，让运河驳船通过。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lockman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浮华的, 矫饰的, 纨绔的, 傻的
lemmas.def_en: affecting extreme elegance in dress and manner

examples.en: His foppish silk cravat and velvet coat drew amused glances from the crowd.
examples.zh: 他浮华的丝绸领巾和天鹅绒外套引来了人群好笑的目光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foppish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <美><加拿大>(赛马或跑狗中的)正序连赢
lemmas.def_en: a bet that you can pick the first and second finishers in the right order

examples.en: She won a small fortune after correctly predicting the exacta at the racetrack.
examples.zh: 她在赛马场上准确猜中前两名名次后赢得了一小笔财富。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exacta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a compound containing two chlorine atoms per molecule

examples.en: The chemist carefully dissolved the metal dichloride in water to begin the reaction.
examples.zh: 化学家小心地将金属二氯化物溶解在水中以开始反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dichloride 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tropical woody herb with showy yellow flowers and flat pods; much cultivated in the tropics

examples.en: We enjoyed a warm bowl of spicy lentil dhal served with fresh naan.
examples.zh: 我们享用了一碗热气腾腾的辛辣扁豆浓汤，并配上了新鲜的馕饼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dhal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: slightly dark

examples.en: The sky turned a darkish gray just before the heavy thunderstorm began.
examples.zh: 就在暴风雨开始之前，天空变成了微暗的灰色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 darkish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 持久的, 耐用的( durable的名词复数 )
lemmas.def_en: consumer goods that are not destroyed by use

examples.en: Consumer spending on consumer durables like refrigerators and washing machines fell sharply.
examples.zh: 消费者在冰箱和洗衣机等耐用品上的支出大幅下降。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 durables 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 厨房, 船内厨房, 野外烧煮场
lemmas.def_en: the area for food preparation on a ship

examples.en: The savory smell of roasted meat drifted across the military camp cookhouse.
examples.zh: 烤肉的香味从军营厨房飘散出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cookhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 作同等扩张的, 作同等延伸的
lemmas.def_en: being of equal extent or scope or duration

examples.en: In this small island nation, the city limits are coextensive with the state.
examples.zh: 在这个小岛国，城市的边界与整个国家的疆域完全一致。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coextensive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of the same period

examples.en: The ancient Greek pottery pieces were coeval with the nearby temple ruins.
examples.zh: 这些古希腊陶器与附近的神庙遗址属于同一时代。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coeval 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: congenital deformity of the foot usually marked by a curled shape or twisted position of the ankle and heel and toes

examples.en: The orthopedic surgeon successfully corrected the infant's congenital clubfoot through early treatment.
examples.zh: 骨科医生通过早期治疗成功矫正了婴儿的先天性畸形足。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clubfoot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a policy of supporting the influence and power of the clergy in secular or political matters

examples.en: The revolutionary leaders actively fought against clericalism to establish a secular government.
examples.zh: 革命领导人积极反对教权主义，以建立一个世俗政府。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clericalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cookout at the seashore where clams and fish and other foods are cooked--usually on heated stones covered with seaweed

examples.en: Our family hosted an annual summer clambake on the sandy ocean beach.
examples.zh: 我们家每年夏天都会在沙滩上举办一次烤蛤野餐会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clambake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: durable aromatic wood of any of numerous cedar trees; especially wood of the red cedar often used for cedar chests

examples.en: The closet smelled faintly of fresh cedarwood, keeping the moths away from wool coats.
examples.zh: 壁橱里有淡淡的新鲜雪松木味，使羊毛大衣免受虫蛀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cedarwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tall erect herbs with sword-shaped leaves; cosmopolitan in fresh and salt marshes

examples.en: Brown cattails swayed gently along the shallow muddy edges of the quiet pond.
examples.zh: 棕色的香蒲在宁静池塘浅浅的泥泞边轻轻摇曳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cattail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: vulgar slang for anus

examples.en: The cellar master carefully pulled the wooden plug from the barrel's bunghole.
examples.zh: 酒窖主管小心翼翼地从木桶孔中拔出木塞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bunghole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a female horse used for breeding

examples.en: After a successful racing career, the chestnut mare was retired as a broodmare.
examples.zh: 在成功的赛马生涯后，那匹栗色母马退役成为繁育母马。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broodmare 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the membranes lining the bronchioles

examples.en: The pediatrician diagnosed the wheezing infant with mild bronchiolitis caused by a virus.
examples.zh: 儿科医生诊断出这名气喘婴儿患有病毒引起的轻度细支气管炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bronchiolitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼓胀的, 柔软而膨松的
lemmas.def_en: being puffed out; used of hair style or clothing

examples.en: She wore her hair in an elaborate bouffant style popular in the sixties.
examples.zh: 她梳着一种在六十年代很流行的蓬松发型。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bouffant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (forestry / Scottish) To spin a floating log rapidly with the feet in a contest, or pour drink.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 birling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 便盆, 暖床用长柄炭炉
lemmas.def_en: a shallow vessel used by a bedridden patient for defecation and urination

examples.en: The nurse slipped a sterile bedpan beneath the elderly patient before leaving.
examples.zh: 护士在离开前将一个无菌便盆塞到了老年患者身下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedpan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赞辞, 称赞, 赞美
lemmas.def_en: a formal expression of praise

examples.en: The retiring professor listened humbly to the glowing encomium delivered by his colleague.
examples.zh: 这位退休教授谦虚地倾听着同事发表的热情洋溢的颂词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 encomium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several bog orchids of the genus Arethusa having 1 or 2 showy flowers

examples.en: While hiking in the boggy woods, she spotted a rare pink arethusa in bloom.
examples.zh: 在沼泽林地徒步时，她看到一朵罕见的粉色水神兰正在绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arethusa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an official in a British hospital who looks after the social and material needs of the patients

examples.en: The abbey's almoner distributed loaves of fresh bread to the poor each morning.
examples.zh: 修道院的施赈员每天早晨向穷人分发新鲜的面包。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 almoner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of magnetic moment of a molecular or atomic or subatomic particle

examples.en: Physicists measured the atomic magnetic moment using the theoretical value of the Bohr magneton.
examples.zh: 物理学家利用玻尔磁子的理论值测量了原子磁矩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 magneton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女冒险家, 女投机家
lemmas.def_en: a woman adventurer

examples.en: Rumors portrayed her as a clever adventuress who married into high society for wealth.
examples.zh: 传闻将她描绘成一个为了财富嫁入上流社会的聪明女投机家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adventuress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 教主, 高僧, 掌权者
lemmas.def_en: a person who holds a high position in a hierarchy

examples.en: The church hierarch blessed the congregation during the solemn annual cathedral service.
examples.zh: 教会高级神职人员在庄严的年度大教堂礼拜中为会众祈福。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hierarch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 碑文, 题铭, 碑铭研究, 金石学
lemmas.def_en: the study of ancient inscriptions

examples.en: His extensive research in Greek epigraphy helped decode several damaged marble inscriptions.
examples.zh: 他在希腊铭文学方面的广泛研究帮助破译了几处受损的大理石铭文。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epigraphy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an acrobatic feat in which a person balances on the head (usually with the help of the hands)

examples.en: She managed to balance steadily in a headstand during the morning yoga class.
examples.zh: 她在早晨的瑜伽课上成功保持了稳定的头倒立姿势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headstand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: out of proportion

examples.en: Critics argued that the new tax placed a disproportional burden on lower-income families.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为新税给低收入家庭造成了不成比例的负担。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disproportional 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various grasses that are tall and that flourish with abundant moisture

examples.en: Vast stretches of native tallgrass prairie once covered much of the central plains.
examples.zh: 大片大片的本土高草草原曾经覆盖了中部平原的大部分地区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tallgrass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the wife of a sheik

examples.en: The wealthy sheikha funded the construction of several art museums in the region.
examples.zh: 这位富有的谢赫夫人资助了该地区几座艺术博物馆的建设。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sheikha 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the shoemaker's trade

examples.en: He learned the traditional craft of shoemaking from his grandfather in northern Italy.
examples.zh: 他在意大利北部向祖父学习了传统的制鞋手艺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shoemaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: between or among tribes

examples.en: The treaty successfully brought an end to decades of violent intertribal warfare.
examples.zh: 该条约成功结束了长达数十年的残酷部落间战争。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intertribal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a projectile made by chewing a piece of paper and shaping it into a sphere

examples.en: The mischievous student blew a wet spitball across the classroom toward the blackboard.
examples.zh: 那个淘气的学生将一个湿纸团吹向教室那头的黑板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spitball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bandage of elastic fabric applied to uplift a dependant part (as the scrotum or a pendulous breast)

examples.en: The patient wore a medical suspensory to support his injured muscles after surgery.
examples.zh: 手术后，该患者佩戴了医用悬带以支撑受伤的肌肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suspensory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 特芙娜（服装公司名, Tapenade）
lemmas.def_en: a spread consisting of capers and black olives and anchovies made into a puree with olive oil

examples.en: She bought a fashionable new dress from the trendy boutique Tapenade yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天在时髦的特芙娜精品店买了一条时尚的新裙子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tapenade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tumor consisting of a mixture of tissues not normally found at that site

examples.en: The surgeon successfully removed a benign ovarian teratoma during the routine operation.
examples.zh: 外科医生在常规手术中成功切除了一个良性卵巢畸胎瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teratoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 过从甚密, 共饮, 交谈
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ with) (informal) To socialize and chat friendly with rich, famous, or influential people.

examples.en: The young director loves to hobnob with Hollywood celebrities at film festivals.
examples.zh: 这位年轻导演喜欢在电影节上与好莱坞名流们结交交谈。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hobnob 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易怒的, 暴躁的, 突然发脾气的
lemmas.def_en: easily irritated or annoyed

examples.en: Lack of sleep often makes him tetchy and prone to petty arguments.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足常常让他变得易怒，容易因琐事争吵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tetchy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 受过完善训练的, 彻底的
lemmas.def_en: performed comprehensively and completely

examples.en: The company underwent a thoroughgoing reform to eliminate all financial inefficiencies.
examples.zh: 该公司经历了一场彻底的改革，以消除所有的财务低效问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thoroughgoing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a lottery in which tickets are drawn from a revolving drum

examples.en: Local villagers gathered at the fair to try their luck at the charity tombola.
examples.zh: 当地村民聚集在集市上，想在慈善摸彩抽奖中试试手气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tombola 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tight-fitting trousers; usually of tartan

examples.en: He proudly wore traditional tartan trews to the formal Scottish celebration.
examples.zh: 他骄傲地穿着传统的苏格兰格子呢裤参加正式的苏格兰庆典。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trews 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of engineering that deals with the interaction of surfaces in relative motion (as in bearings or gears): their design and friction and wear and lubrication

examples.en: Engineers apply principles of tribology to reduce friction and extend machine lifespan.
examples.zh: 工程师们应用摩擦学原理来减少摩擦并延长机器的使用寿命。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tribology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 出一份价钱可购得两份的货
lemmas.def_en: an offer of two for the price of one

examples.en: The theater offered a special twofer deal on tickets for opening night.
examples.zh: 剧院在首演之夜推出了买一赠一的双份优惠票。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 twofer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 单方面政策(的实行), 单方面裁军
lemmas.def_en: the doctrine that nations should conduct their foreign affairs individualistically without the advice or involvement of other nations

examples.en: Critics argued that such diplomatic unilateralism would alienate key international allies.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为，这种外交单边主义会疏远关键的国际盟友。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unilateralism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of brass instruments) having valves

examples.en: The technician inspected the valved brass pipeline for any signs of leakage.
examples.zh: 技术人员检查了装有阀门的黄铜管道，看是否有泄漏迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 valved 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a working woman who takes in washing

examples.en: The weary washerwoman spent the entire morning scrubbing heavy linen by the river.
examples.zh: 疲惫的洗衣女工在河边洗了一上午厚重的亚麻布。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 washerwoman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: traveling especially on foot

examples.en: The kind family offered warm shelter to the wayfaring stranger during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，这户善良的人家为旅途中的陌生人提供了温暖的避难所。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wayfaring 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (滑雪中)作双板平行摆动转弯滑
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (skiing) To ski down a slope making a rapid series of short, parallel turns with knees together.

examples.en: Skilled skiers can wedel effortlessly down the steep, snow-covered mountain slope.
examples.zh: 技术娴熟的滑雪者可以轻松自如地在陡峭的积雪山坡上摆动转弯滑下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wedel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is regarded as eccentric or mad

examples.en: Do not pay attention to that street whacko screaming bizarre conspiracy theories.
examples.zh: 别理会那个在街上大喊离奇阴谋论的怪人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whacko 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a very contagious infection of the skin; common in children; localized redness develops into small blisters that gradually crust and erode

examples.en: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic ointment to treat the child's facial impetigo.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种抗生素软膏来治疗那名儿童的面部脓疱病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impetigo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: senseless talk

examples.en: She dismissed his ridiculous excuse as complete hooey and walked away angrily.
examples.zh: 她把他的荒唐借口斥为一派胡言，然后愤怒地走开了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hooey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extremely fine or thin, as in a spectral line split into two or more components

examples.en: Physicists measured the hyperfine structure of the atom using high-precision lasers.
examples.zh: 物理学家利用高精度激光测量了该原子的超精细结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyperfine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雇工, 可被雇用者, 佣工, 雇员
lemmas.def_en: a person who works only for money

examples.en: The corrupt politician hired a shameless hireling to spread malicious rumors online.
examples.zh: 那个腐败政客雇佣了一个无耻之徒在网上散播恶意谣言。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hireling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: similarity in appearance or character or nature between persons or things

examples.en: The detailed wax figure bore an uncanny similitude to the real historical king.
examples.zh: 那个逼真的蜡像与历史上真实的国王有着不可思议的相似。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 similitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]嗜铬细胞瘤( 一种交感神经系统的肿瘤)
lemmas.def_en: a vascular tumor of the adrenal gland; hypersecretion of epinephrine results in intermittent or sustained hypertension

examples.en: Severe headaches and sudden high blood pressure led doctors to diagnose a pheochromocytoma.
examples.zh: 剧烈头痛和突发高血压促使医生诊断出嗜铬细胞瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pheochromocytoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an inheritable character that is controlled by several genes at once; of or related to or determined by polygenes

examples.en: Human skin color is a polygenic trait determined by multiple interacting genes.
examples.zh: 人类的肤色是一种由多个相互作用的基因决定的多基因遗传特征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polygenic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a faulty shot in billiards; the cue tip slips off the cue ball

examples.en: An unfortunate miscue by the goalkeeper allowed the opposing team an easy goal.
examples.zh: 守门员一次不幸的失误让对方轻松进球得分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 miscue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of tempo) moderate

examples.en: The pianist played the opening movement at a steady moderato tempo.
examples.zh: 钢琴家以平稳的中速弹奏了开篇乐章。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moderato 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the soccer or hockey player assigned to protect the goal

examples.en: The agile netminder blocked three consecutive shots to secure the championship victory.
examples.zh: 这位敏捷的守门员连续挡出三记射门，锁定了冠军胜局。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 netminder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: equal to zero when raised to a certain power

examples.en: In linear algebra, a nilpotent matrix eventually yields the zero matrix when raised to high powers.
examples.zh: 在线性代数中，幂零矩阵在提高到一定幂次时最终会产生零矩阵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nilpotent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (印度军警用的)包铁粗杖, 警棍
lemmas.def_en: club consisting of a heavy stick (often bamboo) bound with iron; used by police in India

examples.en: Police officers armed with wooden lathis quickly dispersed the unruly crowd in the square.
examples.zh: 配备木制长警棍的警察迅速驱散了广场上骚乱的人群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lathi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who takes care of a garden

examples.en: The experienced nurseryman advised us on how to protect the young saplings during winter.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的苗木工向我们建议了如何在冬季保护幼苗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nurseryman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the inner pale yellow part of the lenticular nucleus

examples.en: Deep brain stimulation targeting the pallidum helps reduce severe tremors in Parkinson's patients.
examples.zh: 针对苍白球的脑深部电刺激有助于减轻帕金森病患者的严重震颤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pallidum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: to a moderately sufficient extent or degree

examples.en: Although he had never lived abroad, he spoke French passably well during his trip.
examples.zh: 尽管他从未在国外生活过，但他在旅行期间法语说得还算过得去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 passably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 珠母般的, 有珍珠般光泽的
lemmas.def_en: having a play of lustrous rainbow colors

examples.en: She chose a pearlescent white paint that shimmered gracefully under the bright showroom lights.
examples.zh: 她选择了一种珠光白油漆，在展厅明亮的灯光下散发着优雅的光泽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pearlescent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <美><加拿大>(赛马或跑狗中的)正序连赢
lemmas.def_en: a bet that you can pick the first and second finishers in the right order

examples.en: He won a huge payout after correctly betting on the exacta and the perfecta.
examples.zh: 他在精准押中连赢和正序连赢后，赢得了巨额奖金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perfecta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a marginal note written by a scholiast (a commentator on ancient or classical literature)

examples.en: The ancient Greek manuscript was heavily annotated with medieval scholia in the wide margins.
examples.zh: 这份古希腊手稿宽阔的页边上密密麻麻地写满了中世纪的注释。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scholia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 司法官, 高等法院法官
lemmas.def_en: formerly a high judicial officer

examples.en: In medieval Scotland, the justiciary traveled across the country administering royal justice to criminals.
examples.zh: 在中世纪的苏格兰，高级司法官巡回全国，代表王室审判罪犯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 justiciary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: more than perfect

examples.en: Our English teacher asked us to identify the pluperfect tense verbs in the short story.
examples.zh: 英语老师让我们找出短篇小说中过去完成时的动词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pluperfect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不合逻辑, 缺乏逻辑
lemmas.def_en: invalid or incorrect reasoning

examples.en: The committee members easily pointed out the sheer illogic underlying the mayor's budget proposal.
examples.zh: 委员会成员们轻易指出了市长预算提案背后彻头彻尾的不合理性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 illogic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 20th letter of the Hebrew alphabet

examples.en: The student learned to write resh, the twentieth letter of the Hebrew alphabet, today.
examples.zh: 这个学生今天学会了书写希伯来语的第二十个字母“resh”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 resh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 转播, 转发, 中继站发送
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (telecommunications) To broadcast or send a radio, television, or data signal onward again.

examples.en: The communication satellite will retransmit the weather data back to the ground station immediately.
examples.zh: 通信卫星将立即把气象数据转发回地面站。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retransmit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the practice of proselytizing

examples.en: The constitution protects religious freedom while strictly prohibiting aggressive proselytism in public schools.
examples.zh: 宪法在保护宗教自由的同时，严格禁止在公立学校进行激进的传教活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proselytism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an Islamic judge

examples.en: The disputing merchants presented their contractual evidence before the local qadi for final arbitration.
examples.zh: 发生争议的商人们向当地法官出示了合同证据以作最终仲裁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 qadi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大口喝下的酒, 痛饮
lemmas.def_en: a hearty draft

examples.en: After a grueling hike up the mountain, we enjoyed a refreshing quaff of cold ale.
examples.zh: 在艰苦的登山徒步之后，我们畅饮了一大口爽口的冰啤酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quaff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: shaped like a boat

examples.en: He fell on his outstretched hand and suffered a painful fracture of the scaphoid bone.
examples.zh: 他手掌撑地跌倒，导致舟状骨发生了疼痛的骨折。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scaphoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 半独立国家的政府组织, 半官方机构
lemmas.def_en: a quasi nongovernmental organization; an organization that is financed by the government yet acts independently of the government

examples.en: Critics argued that the newly created quango was wasting public funds without adequate oversight.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为，新设立的半官方机构在缺乏充分监督的情况下浪费了公共资金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quango 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 裂, 裂口, 呵欠
lemmas.def_en: a gaping grimace

examples.en: A sudden rictus of pure horror spread across her face as the floor gave way.
examples.zh: 随着地板塌陷，一张因极度惊恐而扭曲张开的嘴出现在她的脸上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rictus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: restricting according to rules or principles

examples.en: The government established a new regulative body to oversee corporate compliance with emissions standards.
examples.zh: 政府成立了一个新的管理机构，以监督企业对排放标准的合规情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 regulative 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 把(植物)移植于其他(较大)盆中
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (gardening) To move a houseplant into a new pot with fresh soil as it grows larger.

examples.en: You need to repot the indoor ficus because its thick roots are outgrowing this container.
examples.zh: 你需要给这盆室内榕树换盆，因为它的粗根已经长得超出这个容器了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 repot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sparing in consumption of especially food and drink; - John Galsworthy

examples.en: Despite attending lavish banquets frequently, the diplomat remained abstemious in his eating and drinking.
examples.zh: 尽管经常参加奢华宴会，这位外交官在饮食上依然十分克制节俭。

lemmas.def_en: restricted to bare necessities

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abstemious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (medicine / sports) To stretch or straighten a joint (such as a knee or elbow) forcefully beyond its normal range of motion.

examples.en: The gymnast was warned not to hyperextend her knee while landing from the high bar.
examples.zh: 体操运动员被警告从高杠落地时不要过度伸展膝关节。

lemmas.def_en: greater than normal extension

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyperextend 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ on/upon) To bring back and enforce a tax, ban, curfew, or rule that had previously been lifted.

examples.en: Health authorities decided to reimpose strict lockdown measures after infection rates spiked dramatically again.
examples.zh: 在感染率再次急剧上升后，卫生部门决定重新实施严格的封锁措施。

lemmas.def_en: imposition again

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reimpose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a minute red or purple spot on the surface of the skin as the result of tiny hemorrhages of blood vessels in the skin (as in typhoid fever)

examples.en: The doctor noticed tiny petechiae scattered across the patient's lower legs.
examples.zh: 医生注意到患者小腿上分布着微小的瘀点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 petechia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to areas between the layers of the skin

examples.en: The nurse administered an intradermal skin test to check for any allergic reaction.
examples.zh: 护士进行了皮内皮试，以检查是否有过敏反应。

lemmas.def_en: into the skin

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intradermal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a chamber (often underground) reinforced against bombing and provided with food and living facilities; used during air raids

examples.en: Civilians rushed into the underground bombproof as the air raid sirens wailed.
examples.zh: 防空警报响起时，平民们冲进了地下防空掩体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bombproof 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a native or inhabitant of Nova Scotia

examples.en: The local bluenoses protested against the new comedy club opening downtown.
examples.zh: 当地的老顽固们抗议在市中心新开一家喜剧俱乐部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bluenose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自动, 自动作用, 无意识的行为
lemmas.def_en: any reaction that occurs automatically without conscious thought or reflection (especially the undirected behavior seen in psychomotor epilepsy)

examples.en: Under deep hypnosis, the subject showed signs of motor automatism.
examples.zh: 在深度催眠下，受试者表现出运动自动症的迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 automatism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: meat that is salted and cut into strips and dried in the sun

examples.en: He packed some homemade beef biltong for sustained energy during the hike.
examples.zh: 他带了些自制牛肉干，以便在徒步途中补充体力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biltong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an unbroken or imperfectly broken mustang

examples.en: The experienced cowboy managed to calm the wild broncho within minutes.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的牛仔在几分钟内就安抚住了那匹野马。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broncho 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who humbles himself as a sign of respect; who behaves as if he had no self-respect

examples.en: Nobody in the office respected him because he acted like a shameless bootlicker.
examples.zh: 办公室里没人尊重他，因为他像个无耻的马屁精。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bootlicker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the phenomenon of a propagating wave (light or sound) being thrown back from a surface

examples.en: The anatomical chart clearly showed the peritoneal reflexion over the pelvic organs.
examples.zh: 解剖图清晰地显示了盆腔器官上方的腹膜反折。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reflexion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蛛形纲动物, 蛛网膜
lemmas.def_en: the middle of the 3 meninges

examples.en: Cerebrospinal fluid flows through the delicate space beneath the arachnoid membrane.
examples.zh: 脑脊液流经蛛网膜下方的精细腔隙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arachnoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a course of appetizers in an Italian meal

examples.en: We ordered a classic Italian antipasto featuring cured meats and marinated olives.
examples.zh: 我们点了一道经典的意式冷盘开胃菜，配有腌肉和腌橄榄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antipasto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (especially of vectors) parallel but oppositely directed

examples.en: The two strands of DNA run in antiparallel directions within the double helix.
examples.zh: DNA 的两条链在双螺旋结构中呈反平行方向延伸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antiparallel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flesh of shad-like fish abundant along the Atlantic coast or in coastal streams

examples.en: The friendly alewife served warm cider to the weary travelers at dusk.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，友好的酒馆女掌柜给疲惫的旅客端上了热苹果酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alewife 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who plays the accordion

examples.en: A talented street accordionist played lively folk tunes near the central fountain.
examples.zh: 一位才华横溢的街头手风琴师在中央喷泉旁演奏着轻快的民间曲调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 accordionist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short nail with a thick head; used to protect the soles of boots

examples.en: He replaced the worn hobnails on the soles of his heavy mountaineering boots.
examples.zh: 他更换了厚重登山靴鞋底上磨损的鞋钉。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (historical) To reinforce the soles of heavy work boots with short, thick-headed nails.

examples.en: He replaced the worn hobnails on the soles of his heavy mountaineering boots.
examples.zh: 他更换了厚重登山靴鞋底上磨损的鞋钉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hobnail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the cavity in which the large intestine begins and into which the ileum opens

examples.en: The surgeon carefully examined the inflamed appendix attached to the cecum.
examples.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了连接在盲肠上的发炎阑尾。

lemmas.def_en: of or like a cecum

examples.en: The surgeon discovered a small perforation in the patient's cecal wall during surgery.
examples.zh: 外科医生在手术过程中发现患者的盲肠壁上有一个小穿孔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cecum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a barn for cows

examples.en: The farmer led the dairy cows back into the warm byre before nightfall.
examples.zh: 天黑前，农夫把奶牛赶回了温暖的牛栏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 byre 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: for which money is paid

examples.en: The court determined that her repetitive strain injury was a compensable workplace condition.
examples.zh: 法院裁定，她的重复性劳损属于可获得赔偿的工伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 compensable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] ('chirk up') (North American informal) To become more cheerful and lively, or cheer someone up.

examples.en: The good news seemed to chirk him up after a week of disappointment.
examples.zh: 经历了一周的沮丧后，这个好消息似乎让他重新振作了起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chirk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 试用人员, 见习护士, 见习生, 见习人员, 缓刑犯
lemmas.def_en: a nurse in training who is undergoing a trial period

examples.en: The senior officer assigned a simple patrol route to the nervous probationer.
examples.zh: 高级警官给紧张的见习警员分配了一条简单的巡逻路线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 probationer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 新保守派, 新保守主义
lemmas.def_en: an approach to politics or theology that represents a return to a traditional point of view (in contrast to more liberal or radical schools of thought of the 1960s)

examples.en: His foreign policy views were heavily influenced by the rise of neoconservatism.
examples.zh: 他的外交政策观点深受新保守主义兴起的影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neoconservatism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 孳生地, 孵卵所, 发生处
lemmas.def_en: a central point or locus of an infection in an organism

examples.en: Stagnant water in discarded tires serves as an ideal nidus for mosquito larvae.
examples.zh: 废弃轮胎里的死水是蚊子幼虫理想的滋生地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nidus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奥比巫术, 奥比巫术所用的符咒
lemmas.def_en: (West Indies) followers of a religious system involving witchcraft and sorcery

examples.en: Locals whispered that the mysterious illness was caused by powerful obeah charms.
examples.zh: 当地人窃窃私语，说这种怪病是由强效的奥比巫术符咒引起的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obeah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 远洋航行的, 海上旅行的
lemmas.def_en: used on the high seas

examples.en: The port was specially deepened to accommodate modern oceangoing container vessels.
examples.zh: 港口专门进行了疏浚加深，以容纳现代远洋集装箱货轮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oceangoing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a trained worker who is not a member of a profession but who assists a professional

examples.en: A trained paraprofessional assisted the teacher with classroom management every morning.
examples.zh: 一名训练有素的助教每天早上协助老师进行课堂管理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paraprofessional 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 光的, 发光的, 感光的, 与光有关的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by light

examples.en: Most marine life thrives in the ocean's sunlit photic zone.
examples.zh: 大多数海洋生物都在阳光充足的透光带繁茂生长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: foreseeing the future

examples.en: She claimed to have a precognitive dream warning of the accident.
examples.zh: 她声称自己做了一个具有预知能力的梦，预警了这场事故。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 precognitive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: strong flexible twig

examples.en: He gathered flexible withy branches to weave sturdy garden baskets.
examples.zh: 他收集了柔韧的柳条来编织坚固的花园篮子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 withy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <美口>“湿背人”(尤指非法进入美国的墨西哥人)
lemmas.def_en: (ethnic slur) offensive term for a person of Mexican descent

examples.en: The derogatory term wetback historically referred to migrants crossing the border.
examples.zh: 贬义词“湿背人”在历史上指的是越过边境的移民。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wetback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a receipt given by the carrier to the shipper acknowledging receipt of the goods being shipped and specifying the terms of delivery

examples.en: The courier checked the waybill to confirm the shipment's final destination.
examples.zh: 快递员核对了运货单，以确认货物的最终目的地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waybill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 热心肠的, 友好的, 温情的, 亲切的
lemmas.def_en: marked by warmth of feeling like kindness and sympathy and generosity

examples.en: Our warmhearted neighbor baked fresh bread for everyone on the street.
examples.zh: 我们热心肠的邻居为整条街的每个人都烤了新鲜面包。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 warmhearted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a local infection induced in humans by inoculation with the virus causing cowpox in order to confer resistance to smallpox; normally lasts three weeks and leaves a pitted scar

examples.en: Scientists utilized the vaccinia virus to develop an effective smallpox vaccine.
examples.zh: 科学家利用牛痘病毒研制出了有效的天花疫苗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vaccinia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能匹敌的, 不能相配的
lemmas.def_en: eminent beyond or above comparison

examples.en: Her unmatchable vocal talent earned her a standing ovation from everyone.
examples.zh: 她无与伦比的歌唱天赋赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unmatchable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rare doglike carnivorous marsupial of Tasmania having stripes on its back; probably extinct

examples.en: The Tasmanian thylacine was officially declared extinct in the twentieth century.
examples.zh: 塔斯马尼亚袋狼在二十世纪被正式宣布灭绝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thylacine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: chorea in dogs

examples.en: The doctor observed involuntary muscle jerks indicative of progressive chorea.
examples.zh: 医生观察到了预示着进行性舞蹈病的不自主肌肉抽搐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chorea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a garment similar to a jacket that is used to bind the arms tightly against the body as a means of restraining a violent person

examples.en: Hospital staff restrained the violent patient in a padded straightjacket.
examples.zh: 医院工作人员用一件有衬垫的紧身衣制服了这名有暴力倾向的患者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 straightjacket 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: butterfly-shaped bone at the base of the skull

examples.en: The surgeon carefully examined the fracture located near the sphenoid bone.
examples.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了位于蝶骨附近的骨折处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sphenoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 傲慢的, 轻蔑的, 微臭的
lemmas.def_en: having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy; ; ; ; ; ; ; - W.L.Shirer

examples.en: She gave a sniffy response when asked about her rival's achievements.
examples.zh: 当被问及竞争对手的成就时，她给出了轻蔑的回应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sniffy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: helicopter carrying a reel of steel cable that can be used to lift and transport heavy objects

examples.en: The rescue helicopter deployed a skyhook to lift stranded hikers safely.
examples.zh: 救援直升机使用机载吊索将滞留的徒步旅行者安全吊起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skyhook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 欺骗, 诡计, 诈骗
lemmas.def_en: verbal misrepresentation intended to take advantage of you in some way

examples.en: The investigative reporter uncovered financial skullduggery within the corrupt company.
examples.zh: 调查记者揭露了这家腐败公司内部的财务欺诈行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skullduggery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 硅宾; 硅烯; 烷基亚甲硅基
lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Silene

examples.en: Chemists synthesized a reactive silene containing a silicon-carbon double bond.
examples.zh: 化学家合成了一种含有硅碳双键的高反应活性硅烯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the inner and thicker of the two bones of the human leg between the knee and ankle

examples.en: He suffered a painful fracture to his shinbone during the soccer match.
examples.zh: 他在足球比赛中不幸胫骨骨折，疼痛难忍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shinbone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who indulges in excessive sentimentality

examples.en: As an incurable sentimentalist, he kept every single love letter he received.
examples.zh: 作为一个不可救药的感伤主义者，他保留了收到的每一封情书。

lemmas.def_en: the excessive expression of tender feelings, nostalgia, or sadness in any form

examples.en: The critic dismissed the romantic novel as pure sentimentalism without any depth.
examples.zh: 评论家对这部浪漫小说不屑一顾，认为它纯属感伤主义毫无深度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sentimentalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <俄>地下出版物; 私出版物
lemmas.def_en: a system of clandestine printing and distribution of dissident or banned literature

examples.en: Dissidents secretly circulated banned political essays through clandestine samizdat networks.
examples.zh: 异见人士通过秘密的地下出版网络暗中流传被禁的政治文章。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 samizdat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 敕令, 诏书, 抄书
lemmas.def_en: a reply by a Pope to an inquiry concerning a point of law or morality

examples.en: The emperor issued a rescript ordering the immediate release of political prisoners.
examples.zh: 皇帝颁布了一道敕令，下令立即释放政治犯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rescript 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a painted or carved screen placed above and behind an altar or communion table

examples.en: The carved stone reredos behind the altar depicts scenes from ancient scripture.
examples.zh: 祭坛后面雕刻的石质装饰屏风描绘了古代经文的场景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reredos 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small Old World songbird with a reddish breast

examples.en: A little redbreast landed on the snowy branch outside my bedroom window.
examples.zh: 一只小红胸鸲落在了我卧室窗外积雪的树枝上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redbreast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (chemistry, physics) capable of being mixed

examples.en: Ethanol and water are completely miscible in all proportions without separating.
examples.zh: 乙醇和水在任何比例下都能完全互溶而不会分层。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 miscible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tumor arising in the meninges which surround the brain and spinal cord; usually slow growing and sometimes malignant

examples.en: Doctors confirmed that the benign meningioma was safely removed during the surgery.
examples.zh: 医生证实，在手术中已安全切除了那个良性脑膜瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meningioma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a kind of pick that is used for digging; has a flat blade set at right angles to the handle

examples.en: He used a heavy mattock to break through the hard, stony soil.
examples.zh: 他用一把沉重的鹤嘴锄凿开了坚硬多石的土壤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mattock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长腿的人；长腿动物；盲蜘蛛
lemmas.def_en: long-legged three-toed black-and-white wading bird of inland ponds and marshes or brackish lagoons

examples.en: I spotted a harmless daddy longlegs crawling slowly up the bathroom wall.
examples.zh: 我看到一只无害的盲蛛正沿着浴室的墙壁慢慢向上爬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 longlegs 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to cilia projecting from the surface of a cell

examples.en: The microscope revealed tiny ciliate organisms moving rapidly across the water slide.
examples.zh: 显微镜下显示微小的纤毛生物在水滴载玻片上快速移动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ciliate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 抗议, 忠告, 规劝
lemmas.def_en: the act of expressing earnest opposition or protest

examples.en: Despite their angry remonstrance, the council approved the controversial new highway plan.
examples.zh: 尽管人们提出了愤怒的抗议，市议会还是批准了这项颇具争议的新公路规划。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 remonstrance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several small ungulate mammals of Africa and Asia with rodent-like incisors and feet with hooflike toes

examples.en: The quick cony darted into its burrow to escape the swooping hawk.
examples.zh: 那只敏捷的兔子冲进地洞，以躲避俯冲而来的鹰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: solid swollen underground bulb-shaped stem or stem base and serving as a reproductive structure

examples.en: Plant the crocus corm in well-drained soil during the late autumn months.
examples.zh: 在深秋时节将番红花球茎种植在排水良好的土壤中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 皮质脂酮, 皮质硬脂酮
lemmas.def_en: secreted by the adrenal cortex; involved in regulating water and electrolyte balance in the body

examples.en: Chronic stress causes a sharp rise in blood corticosterone levels in rodents.
examples.zh: 慢性压力会导致啮齿动物血液中的皮质酮水平急剧上升。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corticosterone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or exhibiting diamagnetism; slightly repelled by a magnet

examples.en: Bismuth is a strongly diamagnetic metal that is weakly repelled by magnets.
examples.zh: 铋是一种强抗磁性金属，会被磁铁微弱排斥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diamagnetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: angle that resembles the hind leg of a dog

examples.en: The fourth hole on the golf course features a sharp dogleg right.
examples.zh: 高尔夫球场的第四洞有一个急剧向右弯曲的球道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dogleg 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the period of greatest prosperity or productivity

examples.en: Moisture inside the brick wall caused an unsightly white efflorescence on the surface.
examples.zh: 砖墙内部的水分导致表面析出难看的白色粉化沉淀物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 efflorescence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: Eurasian rose with prickly stems and fragrant leaves and bright pink flowers followed by scarlet hips

examples.en: The sweet scent of wild eglantine drifted through the open garden gate.
examples.zh: 野生多花蔷薇的清香飘过了开着的院门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eglantine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the intestine (especially the small intestine); usually characterized by diarrhea

examples.en: Severe bacterial enteritis left the traveler dehydrated and confined to bed.
examples.zh: 严重的细菌性肠炎导致该旅行者脱水并卧床不起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enteritis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: at a previous time

examples.en: The erst peaceful village was transformed into a bustling tourist hotspot.
examples.zh: 往昔宁静的村庄如今变成了一个热闹的旅游胜地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 erst 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a freshwater pond with fish

examples.en: Several colorful koi swim peacefully in the stone fishpond behind the house.
examples.zh: 几条色彩斑斓的锦鲤在房子后面的石头鱼池里悠闲游动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fishpond 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a prostitute who attracts customers by walking the streets

examples.en: He foolishly spent all his savings buying lavish gifts for that floozy.
examples.zh: 他愚蠢地花光了所有积蓄，为那个轻佻的女人购买奢华礼物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 floozy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 跗关节, 马脚状铁钩, 斜析形屋顶
lemmas.def_en: a gable roof with two slopes on each side and the lower slope being steeper

examples.en: The old wooden barn features a classic gambrel roof painted bright red.
examples.zh: 这座古老的木制谷仓采用了刷成亮红色的经典复折斜屋顶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gambrel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being more concentrated than normally possible and therefore not in equilibrium

examples.en: The chemist prepared a supersaturated solution that began crystallizing almost immediately.
examples.zh: 化学家制备了一种过饱和溶液，它几乎立即开始结晶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supersaturated 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who tends a flock of goats

examples.en: An elderly goatherd led his flock up the rugged mountain trail at sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出时分，一位年迈的放羊人领着羊群走上了崎岖的山路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goatherd 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tenant who holds a lease

examples.en: The leaseholder is required to pay annual ground rent to the freeholder.
examples.zh: 租赁人必须每年向土地所有者支付地租。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leaseholder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bedroom that is kept for the use of guests

examples.en: We prepared the spare guestroom with fresh sheets for our visiting friends.
examples.zh: 我们为来访的朋友打扫了空闲客房并换上了干净的床单。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guestroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the region inside the heliopause containing the sun and solar system

examples.en: The Voyager spacecraft has officially crossed the boundary of our heliosphere into interstellar space.
examples.zh: 旅行者号航天器已正式越过日光层边界，进入星际空间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heliosphere 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 血钙过多, 高钙血
lemmas.def_en: the presence of abnormally high levels of calcium in the blood; usually the result of excessive bone resorption in hyperparathyroidism or Paget's disease

examples.en: Severe hypercalcemia can cause confusion, muscle weakness, and dangerous cardiac arrhythmias.
examples.zh: 严重的高钙血症可能导致意识模糊、肌肉无力和危险的心律失常。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypercalcemia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an infectious disease of animals and humans (especially newborn or immunosuppressed persons) caused by the bacterium Listeria monocytogenes; in sheep and cattle the infection frequently involves the central nervous system and causes various neurological symptoms

examples.en: Pregnant women are advised to avoid unpasteurized cheese to reduce the risk of contracting listeriosis.
examples.zh: 建议孕妇避免食用未经巴氏消毒的奶酪，以降低感染李司忒氏菌病的风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 listeriosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of muscular tissue) the state of being hypotonic

examples.en: Infants with congenital hypotonia often appear floppy and struggle to hold their heads upright.
examples.zh: 患有先天性肌张力减退的婴儿身体通常显得绵软，难以抬头。

lemmas.def_en: (of living tissue) lacking normal tone or tension

examples.en: Cells placed in a hypotonic solution tend to absorb water rapidly and swell up.
examples.zh: 置于低渗溶液中的细胞往往会迅速吸水并膨胀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypotonia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several congenital diseases in which the skin is dry and scaly like a fish

examples.en: Patients suffering from severe ichthyosis require daily application of intensive moisturizers to manage dry skin.
examples.zh: 患有严重鱼鳞癣的患者需要每天涂抹强效保湿霜来改善干燥皮肤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ichthyosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能溶解的, 不能分解的, 坚固的
lemmas.def_en: (of a substance) incapable of being dissolved

examples.en: Decades of shared hardship forged an indissoluble bond between the two elderly brothers.
examples.zh: 数十年的患难与共在这对老兄弟之间铸就了牢不可破的情谊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indissoluble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an infant who is sponsored by an adult (the godparent) at baptism

examples.en: She sends a thoughtful gift to her young godchild on every single birthday.
examples.zh: 她在教子的每个生日都会送去一份贴心的礼物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 godchild 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an outer protective covering such as the skin of an animal or a cuticle or seed coat or rind or shell

examples.en: The thick outer integument of the seed protects it from freezing winter temperatures.
examples.zh: 种子厚厚的外层覆盖物能保护它免受冬季严寒的侵袭。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the integument

examples.en: The skin is the largest and most protective component of the human integumentary system.
examples.zh: 皮肤是人体外皮系统中最大且最具保护性的组成部分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 integument 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不节制, 过度, 酗酒
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being intemperate

examples.en: His youthful intemperance with alcohol ultimately took a heavy toll on his overall health.
examples.zh: 他年轻时的酗酒无度最终对整体健康造成了沉重打击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intemperance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 纷乱的, 复杂的, 内卷的
lemmas.def_en: especially of petals or leaves in bud; having margins rolled inward

examples.en: The detective struggled to untangle the involute plot woven by the clever criminal syndicate.
examples.zh: 面对狡猾犯罪集团编织的错综复杂的阴谋，侦探费尽了周折。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 involute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a count who had jurisdiction over a large territory in medieval Germany

examples.en: The powerful landgrave ruled his vast medieval territories with a remarkably firm hand.
examples.zh: 这位权势显赫的伯爵领主以极其强硬的手段统治着他广袤的中世纪领地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 landgrave 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 笔迹学, 笔迹相法, 图表法
lemmas.def_en: the study of handwriting (especially as an indicator of the writer's character or disposition)

examples.en: Some personnel managers mistakenly rely on graphology to evaluate the personality of job applicants.
examples.zh: 一些人事经理错误地依靠笔迹学来评估求职者的性格。

lemmas.def_zh: 笔迹学家, 字体学家
lemmas.def_en: a specialist in inferring character from handwriting

family_guide.root_logic: 以 graphology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chiefly British) To protect an industry or workers excessively with subsidies or easy conditions.

examples.en: Critics accused the union of trying to featherbed by mandating redundant staff positions.
examples.zh: 批评人士指责工会试图通过设置冗员岗位来提供闲职。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 featherbed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使成复数；兼职, 成复数形式
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (grammar) To make a singular word plural, or make a society more diverse.

examples.en: In traditional English grammar, you normally pluralize most countable nouns by simply adding an s.
examples.zh: 在传统英语语法中，通常只需加上s即可使大多数可数名词变复数。
